description: Secretaria Municipal de Segurança Urbana (SMSU), City of São Paulo publishes the locations of the municipal urban-security facilities: the units of the Guarda Civil Metropolitana (regional inspectorates, commands and mediation houses), the units of the military service boards and the units of the municipal civil defence coordination (COMDEC), offered as GeoJSON, WFS and WMS layers. Coverage: the municipality of São Paulo; the page says annual update, last in May 2026, and the portal record was modified on 2026-07-23. Format and access: GeoJSON, WFS, WMS, HTML, downloadable without registration from the São Paulo municipal open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Atribuição; cost: free. Caveats: the point layers give locations only, without staffing, vehicles or response areas; the layers were not opened, so the attribute fields and counts are unconfirmed. Simulation uses: emergency-response facility layers for coverage and response-time models and for critical-facility exposure in flood and landslide studies. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
